# package bvlc

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-bacnet/bvlc"
```

Package bvlc implements BACnet Virtual Link Control (BACnet/IP) framing.

bvlc is a sibling wire codec: it may import github.com/otfabric/go-bacnet but must not import npdu or apdu. Payload bytes may alias the input datagram.


### type IPv4Mask

```go
type IPv4Mask [4]byte
```

IPv4Mask is a BACnet/IP broadcast distribution mask (4 octets).

#### func (IPv4Mask) Addr

```go
func (m IPv4Mask) Addr() netip.Addr
```

Addr returns the mask as an IPv4 netip.Addr.

#### func (IPv4Mask) Contiguous

```go
func (m IPv4Mask) Contiguous() bool
```

Contiguous reports whether the mask is a contiguous left-justified bit mask (standard subnet-style). All-zero and all-ones are allowed.

### type Message

```go
type Message struct {
	Function Function
	Payload  []byte

	// ForwardedNPDU origin (set when Function == FunctionForwardedNPDU).
	OriginIP   [4]byte
	OriginPort uint16

	// Result code (set when Function == FunctionResult).
	ResultCode uint16

	// Register-Foreign-Device TTL (seconds).
	TTL uint16
}
```

Message is a parsed BVLC message. Payload aliases the input buffer.
